latest_release.name: v0.14.10
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix race between stopping and starting the receive thread by @iddo in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2142
* Download attachments from synced message edits by @Copilot in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2143
* Accept group invitations addressed to the PNI by @wakamex in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2146
* Deliver the envelope in hand to the last receive handler before it is removed by @wappensc-developer in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2153
* Add native reflection metadata for FinishLinkCommand by @garsteaa in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2154
* Fix native metadata for RegisterCommand$RegistrationParams by @zplizzi in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2150
* Handle oversized attachment dimensions by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2157
* Bump rustls from 0.23.45 to 0.23.46 in /client by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2159
* Expose profile badges in listContacts by @Doaky in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2162
* Add --tls-proxy to connect through a Signal TLS proxy by @wappensc-developer in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2163
* Rotate own sender key when a group member leaves or is removed by @wappensc-developer in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2156
* Add --timestamp option to send command by @tonycpsu in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2147

## New Contributors
* @iddo made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2142
* @wakamex made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2146
* @wappensc-developer made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2153
* @garsteaa made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2154
* @zplizzi made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2150
* @dajiaohuang made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2157
* @Doaky made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/pull/2162

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/compare/v0.14.9...v0.14.10
